messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered for service: inference-runtime-autoscaler
pagerduty: [PAGER] HIGH: autoscaler queue backlog above 85% for 12m — page sent to #eng-oncall (rule=queue.backlog_pct > 80%)
incident-bot: Alert details: metric=queue.backlog_pct, value=87.2, threshold=80, region=us-west-2, affected-route=/v1/generate, recent_errors=504,429. Dashboard: <https://dash.redwood.ai/alerts/12345>
Maya P: ack @pagerduty I'm on it. grabbing logs now. :sweat:
Alex R: joining. quick check — any recent deploys?
ops-bot: no deploys in the last 30m for inference services.
Maya P: looks like autoscaler isn't adding nodes. `k8s-autoscaler` logs show repeated \"quota exceeded\" and \"scale request throttled\"
Maya P: logs snippet:
```
kubectl logs -n infra autoscaler-7f8b9 | tail -n 50
2025-06-10T17:24:12Z scale request -> desired=8 current=4 reason=queue_backlog
2025-06-10T17:24:13Z cloud API error: rateLimitExceeded
2025-06-10T17:24:14Z scale failed retry 1
```
Alex R: cloud provider console shows VM quota at 100% for us-west-2-account-prod. link: https://cloud.vendor/quotas/usw2/prod-account
Tiago L: pinging cloud quotas owner (cc @oncall-rotation). Can we do manual scale temporarily?
Maya P: yes, manual scale: `kubectl scale --replicas=8 deployment/inference-pool-usw2 -n inference` — running now.
Maya P: pod startup shows Pending -> Running, warming caches.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: note added: Maya P manually scaled inference-pool-usw2 to 8 replicas.
Maya P: traffic is starting to drain backlog. queue length dropped from ~14k -> ~3.2k in ~3m. still seeing isolated 504s for some enterprise customers.
Alex R: enabling fallback routing to dedicated pool for high-latency requests (temp rule). command: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/routing \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","dest":"inference-fallback","match":"p95>2000"}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>'
```
Tiago L: I'll take the on-call handoff in ~15m. leaving notes here. severity marked P2; will escalate to P1 if customer impact widens.
sre-shiftlead: recommend escalating to infra oncall if quota isn't adjusted by cloud ops. tagging @cloud-ops.
pagerduty: Alert acknowledged by Maya P
Alex R: quick root-cause hypothesis: provider-side quota/regional throttle causing autoscaler API calls to be rejected; autoscaler currently retries but doesn't failover to another region or use burst nodes.
Maya P: mitigation checklist added to incident doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/incidents/2025-06-10-autoscale-queue-surge
Tiago L: handoff: I'm primary for next 2h; if backlog increases >5k re-page with tag \"backlog-critical\" and escalate to infra-lead.
Maya P: leaving runbook steps in thread and incident doc:
- keep manual replicas until autoscaler recovers or cloud quota is increased
- open support ticket with cloud provider requesting temporary quota bump / soft-limit increase
- monitor metrics: queue.backlog_pct, request_p95_ms, kvcache.hit_rate, pod_startup_latency
- revert routing changes after p95 < 600ms for 10m
Alex R: note for cost owners: manual scaling will spike cloud spend. notify finance if this persists >4h.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation policy: if not resolved/adjusted in 30m escalate to infra-lead.
Maya P: tagging support and enterprise success for affected tenants: support ticket created <https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/87321> — outreach planned with ETA 30m.
Tiago L: ack. taking over now. will update channel for major state changes.
Maya P: thanks all — handing off to @Tiago L. Will stay reachable if needed. :handshake:
Tiago L: ack. starting post-handoff checklist and keeping monitoring window open.
